newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers dip from highs.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers dip from highs.

text.p: North American bunker prices slipped down from highs hit last week as the threat of a tropical storm in the Gulf faded and trade remained moderate, players said.
The storm, Josephine, was downgraded overnight from a tropical storm, and Tuesday was waning further as it moved up the East Coast.
In Houston, 380 CST, which had runup on storm fears on Monday, dipped down Tuesday to between $134 and $135 a tonne, which is still $3 above levels late last week.
"The market is softening," said one trader.
